provenance.py_hash_seed_note: The same PYTHONHASHSEED in all six colony processes, so the hash order is common-mode across colonies and cannot contaminate the between-colony comparison. The unpinned floor was measured: docs/process_noise_3000.json.

M5_development_velocity.last_100_new_rate_note: 0 means the organism discovered nothing new in the final 100 cycles. In a world that repeats, that is the repertoire being exhausted, not development slowing.

discovery.note: cumulative[k][i] is the number of DISTINCT items of kind k discovered by the end of cycle i. A curve that flattens is a repertoire being exhausted, not development slowing. m5_* counts only the four kinds M5 counts, so m5_cycle_cumulative_total ends at M5's inventory_total.
